say:1:1123509001:1.text: Chief, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you for helping us...
say:1:1123509001:1.male: Chief, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you for helping us...
say:1:1123509001:1.female: Chief, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you for helping us...

say:2:1123509002:1.text: A while ago, a strong ironjaw seized this land from other beasts.
say:2:1123509002:1.source_cn: 这片领地曾是一只强大的钢颚兽，从其他野兽那里夺取而来的。

say:3:1123509003:1.text: So, when the ironjaw got injured, the other beasts came to take their territory back.
say:3:1123509003:1.source_cn: 当这只钢颚兽受伤，争夺地盘的其他野兽便想趁机夺回这里。

say:5:1123509004:1.text: Why don't they wait until it gets old and weak?
say:5:1123509004:1.source_cn: 啊？那为什么不趁它年老力衰的时候过来。

say:6:1123509005:1.text: Don't underestimate an aging ironjaw. They might not be as physically fit as before, but they have a lot of experience. Their counterattacks can be very dangerous.
say:6:1123509005:1.source_cn: 不要小瞧年老力衰的钢颚兽，虽然体格大不如从前，但是作战...

say:10:1123509007:1.text: See... Opportunities to learn and grow are everywhere. Hashir, we really need your knowledge and experience.
say:10:1123509007:1.source_cn: 学习和成长的机会无处不在，哈什尔，我们真的需要你的知识...

say:12:1123509009:1.text: The traditions were established to ensure the prosperity of the Grimmaw Clan, remember? Please return to us.
say:12:1123509009:1.source_cn: 传统是服务黑嚎氏族繁荣的，不是吗？回到氏族吧。

say:15:1123509011:1.text: Hopefully, our efforts aren't in vain...
say:15:1123509011:1.source_cn: 希望，我们的努力没有白费……

say:17:1123509012:1.text: I believe in Elder Hashir. He'll surely come around.
say:17:1123509012:1.source_cn: 我相信老师，他一定会想通的！

say:18:1123509013:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, my honored friend, we're heading back to camp. Please visit when you have the time.
say:18:1123509013:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, my honored friend, we're heading back to camp. Please visit when you have the time.
say:18:1123509013:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, my honored friend, we're heading back to camp. Please visit when you have the time.

narration:19:1123509014:1.text: A while later, Kruger invites you to visit the Grimmaw Clan...
